crossrefs.text: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.

And when Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them. “Where have you come from?” he asked. “From the land of Canaan,” they replied. “We are here to buy food.”
When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness—yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times—
Finally, after she had pressed him daily with her words and pleaded until he was sick to death,
Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is like a broken tree.
He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my motherʼs sons,
For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
Now in those days the advice of Ahithophel was like the consultation of the word of God. Such was the regard that both David and Absalom had for Ahithophelʼs advice.
From there, Elisha went up to Bethel, and as he was walking up the road, a group of boys came out of the city and jeered at him, chanting, “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!”
But stretch out Your hand and strike all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face.”
In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.

notes.title: I know that my Redeemer lives
